# Huzada Storefront

> Curated online storefront catalog with transparent pricing, instant web order placement, and direct doorstep delivery.

## Storefront Pages

- [Home & Featured Catalog](https://penia.pages.dev/): Main storefront overview, customer rating summary, operating hours, and featured catalog highlights.
- [Full Product Catalog](https://penia.pages.dev/catalog): Browse, search, and filter all available products with direct checkout support.

## Discovery & Machine-Readable Resources

- [XML Sitemap](https://penia.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): Canonical list of public indexable storefront URLs.
- [Robots Policy](https://penia.pages.dev/robots.txt): Crawler access rules permitting `/` and `/catalog` while disallowing `/admin` and `/api/`.
- [Agent Readiness Descriptor](https://penia.pages.dev/.well-known/ard.json): Structured JSON capability and endpoint descriptor for autonomous agents.
